_meta.purpose: T062 labelled fixture set for reply classification.
_meta.provenance: SYNTHETIC. Every message below was written for this file. None is real employer correspondence, and none may be added from a real mailbox (PLAN.md T062).
_meta.labels: expected is one of the stored classes: acknowledgement, rejection, interview_invite, offer, information_request, unclassified.
_meta.traps: Several entries are written to look like a different class — an invitation phrased with 'pleased to extend', a rejection that thanks the applicant for applying, an ATS digest. They are the cases that matter.

replies.subject: Thank you for your application
replies.body: We have received your application for Process Engineer and our team will review it shortly.

replies.subject: Application received - Quality Manager
replies.body: Your application has been received. We are reviewing all applications and will be in touch.

replies.subject: Thanks for applying to Acme
replies.body: Thank you for applying. This is an automated confirmation that your application was submitted successfully.

replies.subject: Your application to Northwind
replies.body: Thank you for your interest in Northwind. We have received your application and will contact you if there is a match.

replies.subject: We received your application
replies.body: Hello, we received your application for the Industrial Engineer role. No action is needed from you.

replies.subject: Update on your application
replies.body: Thank you for applying. Unfortunately we will not be moving forward with your application at this time. We wish you every success in your job search.

replies.subject: Your application for Process Engineer
replies.body: After careful consideration we have decided to proceed with other candidates whose experience more closely matches the role.

replies.subject: Application outcome
replies.body: We regret to inform you that your application was unsuccessful on this occasion.

replies.subject: Regarding your application
replies.body: We have selected another candidate for this position. We will keep your CV on file for future openings.

replies.subject: Industrial Engineer - update
replies.body: Thank you for your time. We are unable to move forward with your application and will not be progressing it further.

replies.subject: Your application
replies.body: Thanks for applying. The team decided not to move forward with your candidacy. We wish you all the best in your search.

replies.subject: Interview invitation - Process Engineer
replies.body: We would like to invite you to an interview for the Process Engineer role. Would you be available for a call next week?

replies.subject: Next steps
replies.body: Thank you for applying. We would like to schedule a call to discuss the next step in our hiring process. Please book a time using the link below.

replies.subject: Screening call
replies.body: Could we schedule a screening call? Please pick a slot that suits you on calendly.com/acme-talent.

replies.subject: Invitation to interview
replies.body: We are pleased to extend an invitation to interview with our operations team on Tuesday. Would you be available for 45 minutes?

replies.subject: Interview invite: Quality Manager
replies.body: Please choose a time that works for your interview with the plant manager.

replies.subject: Offer of employment
replies.body: We are delighted to offer you the position of Process Engineer. Your offer letter is attached.

replies.subject: Your offer from Northwind
replies.body: Following your interviews we would like to offer you the role. The compensation package is described in the attached employment offer.

replies.subject: Congratulations
replies.body: We are pleased to offer you the position. Please review the offer letter and let us know by Friday.

replies.subject: Technical assessment
replies.body: As the next stage please complete the online assessment by Friday. The link to the HackerRank test is below.

replies.subject: Take-home exercise
replies.body: Please find attached a take-home task. Kindly complete this assessment within five days.

replies.subject: Documents required
replies.body: Please send a copy of your degree and transcript, and proof of identity, before we continue.

replies.subject: A few questions
replies.body: Could you please provide your notice period and salary expectation? Please share them by reply.

replies.subject: References
replies.body: Please provide reference details for two referees from your most recent employer.

replies.subject: Right to work
replies.body: Before an offer can be made please provide proof of your right to work. Please upload your passport.

replies.subject: Visa sponsorship process
replies.body: We have started the visa sponsorship process and will need some information from you for the certificate of sponsorship.

replies.subject: Webinar invite: land your next role
replies.body: Join our free webinar. Limited time offer - 50% off our career course. Unsubscribe at any time.

replies.subject: Opportunity that might interest you
replies.body: I came across your profile and have a role that might be of interest. Are you open to a conversation?

replies.subject: Weekly job alerts
replies.body: Here are this week's new jobs matching your saved search. Manage your email preferences.

replies.subject: Hello
replies.body: Hi, just checking in.

replies.subject: Quick question
replies.body: Is this still your current phone number?

replies.subject: Re: Application
replies.body: Thanks.

replies.subject: Your application status
replies.body: Your application is still under review. We appreciate your patience.

replies.subject: Out of office
replies.body: I am out of the office until Monday with limited access to email.
